result.keyword: How much does it cost to hire a company to build an AI agent, and which firms offer this service?

items.markdown:
Hiring a firm to build a custom AI agent varies widely in cost depending on the architecture, scope, and level of autonomy required.[[1]](https://productcrafters.io/blog/how-much-does-it-cost-to-build-an-ai-agent/)[[2]](https://www.ayautomate.com/blog/ai-agent-development-cost-2026)

### Cost Breakdown to Build an AI Agent

The pricing scales with complexity, moving from simple automated prompts to multi-agent, enterprise-grade ecosystems:

- **Single-Workflow / Simple Agents ($3,000 – $15,000):** 
	- *Scope:* Built for one specific task (e.g., an automated FAQ responder or simple lead router) using basic rules and a single foundational LLM integration. Takes 1–2 weeks.[[1]](https://www.ayautomate.com/blog/ai-agent-development-cost-2026)[[2]](https://productcrafters.io/blog/how-much-does-it-cost-to-build-an-ai-agent/)
- **Production Agents with RAG & Integrations ($15,000 – $75,000):** 
	- *Scope:* Mid-market standard. Connects securely to internal company data (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) and executes multiple API calls or workflow actions.[[1]](https://www.ayautomate.com/blog/ai-agent-development-cost-2026)
- **Multi-Agent Enterprise Systems ($75,000 – $500,000+):** 
	- *Scope:* Complex, autonomous systems for large organizations featuring custom model fine-tuning, multi-tenant architectures, strict compliance (SOC 2, HIPAA), and robust cross-departmental tool orchestration.[[1]](https://productcrafters.io/blog/how-much-does-it-cost-to-build-an-ai-agent/)[[2]](https://www.ayautomate.com/blog/ai-agent-development-cost-2026)
- **Ongoing Maintenance:** Expect annual maintenance and updates to run roughly **15% to 25%** of the initial development cost.[[1]](https://productcrafters.io/blog/how-much-does-it-cost-to-build-an-ai-agent/)

### Firms and Categories Offering AI Agent Services

The landscape is diverse, ranging from massive global tech consultancies to specialized design studios and platform ecosystems:

- **Global Enterprise Consultancies:** Firms like IBM Consulting , Accenture, and Deloitte handle large-scale, enterprise-wide agent deployments, secure integrations, and organizational transformation.[[1]](https://www.pixelmatters.com/insights/top-ai-agent-development-companies)
- **Specialized AI & Software Dev Agencies:** Boutique development shops (such as Product Crafters, Ayautomate, and regional IT solution firms) specialize in rapidly scoping and shipping production-ready, mid-market RAG and workflow agents.[[1]](https://productcrafters.io/blog/how-much-does-it-cost-to-build-an-ai-agent/)[[2]](https://www.ayautomate.com/blog/ai-agent-development-cost-2026)
- **Product & Digital Studios:** Studios like Work & Co, ustwo, and Pixelmatters focus heavily on integrating conversational and autonomous agents smoothly into customer-facing software products or dedicated digital workflows.[[1]](https://www.pixelmatters.com/insights/top-ai-agent-development-companies)
- **Enterprise Ecosystem Platforms:** Companies like [Moveworks](https://www.moveworks.com/us/en/resources/blog/ai-agent-development-company) provide proprietary agent studios and enterprise frameworks designed to let organizations spin up secure workplace agents with less custom-coded overhead.

If you'd like to narrow this down, tell me:

- What is the **primary task or workflow** you want the AI agent to handle?
- Do you need it integrated with **specific enterprise software** (like Salesforce, Jira, or custom databases)?

I can help you estimate a tighter budget or recommend the right approach.
